title: Pricing intake: priority-lane rubric and cost-attribution playbook
creator: Ava Chen
description: Define an operational rubric to triage inbound pricing/packaging and billing requests from enterprise customers. Produce explicit priority lanes, scoring heuristics, required artifacts, routing rules, and a lightweight cost-attribution checklist so Finance, Sales Ops, and PMs can consistently evaluate and resolve non-bug commercial requests (commitments, invoicing, marketplace credits, cost allocation).
intake_flow: 1) Inbound capture: requests come via Support Ticket / Sales Ops form / Partner Portal. All submissions must include customer, product lines affected, ask type (commitment|invoice|marketplace|discount), estimated ARR impact, and desired timeline.
2) Triage inbox (rotating PM): quick validation within 48 hours to confirm ask type and completeness. If missing fields, send standardized intake follow-up template.
3) Score & lane assignment: use scoring matrix (see priority_scoring) to assign lane and owner.
4) Routing & playbook execution: owner runs the lane-specific checklist and coordinates with Finance, Legal, Sales Ops, and Engineering as required.
5) Decision and closure: record outcome in CRM, attach artifacts (SOW, invoice template), and update ticket with resolution and billing tags for downstream reconciliation.
priority_scoring: Score dimensions (0-5 each): ARR impact, Contract complexity, Billing engineering effort, SLA/latency requirements, Revenue recognition risk.
Thresholds: Low (0-6) => Fast-track lane; Medium (7-13) => Standard review; High (14-25) => Executive review and cross-functional kickoff.

Examples: 1) $20k ARR, simple invoice timing change => ARR 1, Contract 0, Billing 1, SLA 0, RR 0 = 2 => Fast-track. 2) Multi-region dedicated capacity commitment with custom SLA and KMS integration => ARR 5, Contract 4, Billing 4, SLA 4, RR 5 = 22 => Executive review.
priority_lanes: Fast-track (0-6): low effort changes that Finance/Sales Ops can approve. Target TAT: 3 business days.
Standard (7-13): PM + Finance + Sales Ops coordinated changes requiring billing template updates or modest infra work. Target TAT: 2-3 sprints.
Investigation (7-13, unknown cost): requires an engineering or accounting spike to estimate effort; timeboxed 5 business days.

Custom Commitment / Enterprise (14+): cross-functional engagement, legal SOW, potential Dedicated/Private implications. Requires Exec approval and finance sign-off. Target TAT: negotiable; pipeline-managed.
Marketplace/Brokerage Exceptions: handled with Marketplace Ops and Finance; may require ledger mapping and offset rules.
routing_matrix: Ask type: Commitment => Owner: PM (Enterprise) + Sales Ops; Stakeholders: Finance, Legal, Engineering if serving changes needed.
Ask type: Invoicing timing/format => Owner: Finance + Sales Ops; Stakeholders: PM for product impact.
Ask type: Cost allocation or tagging => Owner: Finance; Stakeholders: PM and Billing Eng (ENG).
Ask type: Marketplace credits/offsets => Owner: Marketplace Ops; Stakeholders: Finance, PM, Legal.
required_artifacts: Signed contract or draft SOW (for custom commitments).
Invoice sample and GL account mapping (for invoicing changes).
Estimated ARR and recognition cadence in USD and local currency if applicable.
Technical impact note if serving/runtime changes required (include PR links or ticket refs).
Approval matrix from Sales/Customer Success that shows authorized approver.
decision_criteria: Material revenue (ARR threshold configurable; default $50k/year) pushes towards Enterprise lane.
If billing change requires backend schema or new ledger category => add Engineering dependency and move to Standard/Investigation lane.
If legal terms materially alter indemnity/SLAs => escalate to Legal and Enterprise lane.
Marketplace offsets require explicit accounting mapping and may need audit trail for partner revenue share.
cost_attribution_checklist: Identify which product lines and tenant IDs the commitment will consume (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
Estimate GPU-hours or token forecast over commitment period and map to unit cost buckets (batching, KV caching impacts).
Flag whether quantization/slow-path execution will be used for the customer and the expected per-token delta.
Assign billing tag(s) for chargeback and internal cost center mapping before invoice issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Triage owner has assigned lane and created a cross-functional checklist within 3 business days.
All required artifacts are present or a timeboxed investigation ticket is created and scheduled.
Finance has reviewed revenue recognition implications and provided GL mappings.
If engineering work is required, an ENG ticket exists with estimate and dependency noted in this intake record.
operational_playbooks: Fast-track script and templates for common asks (invoice date shift, credit memo issuance, small discounts) maintained in Confluence.
Enterprise commitment playbook: negotiation checklist, SOW template, billing acceptance tests, and post-commitment monitoring plan.
Marketplace exception playbook: ledger mapping template, partner share calculation example, and refund/credit flow.
metrics_and_reporting: TAT to first decision by lane (SLA: Fast-track 3bd, Standard 10bd, Enterprise negotiable).
Accuracy of cost attribution (quarterly audit sample target >95%).
Revenue closed through ad-hoc pricing exceptions vs. standard offers.
